id: # meshcrash: the device mesher's illegal memory access on the dev host (renderprec-anvil-cumesh, fixed there) and what its hunt found

cause: cumesh_run's overflow redraw (a lane's run past its 512-vertex buffer: every lane draws again) went straight into the full-warp shuffles of the vertex offsets with no barrier or warp sync (SASS: CALL then SHFL.UP, ptxas taking the warp as one), while a draw can leave the warp split (renderprec-anvil-cumesh): the offsets could be summed from lanes not there; not seen to fail on the dev host, a candidate for perfhost-cumesh-null (explore, many envs a stream: large launches take the run kernels)
pin: make -s -C csrc/runtime pipe-gate MESH=2 DRAW=1; explore stress (pipe_bench --kinds explore --device-mesh 1 --env-seeds)
